theorems.statement: For a finite Newton jet with rational polynomial coefficients, a first exactly selected irrational translated root beta may be adopted as the sole selected-root evaluation generator A_beta; the residual jet remains finite over rational-valuation Newton scales, and later rational translated roots continue exactly in the same carrier.  If coefficients already lie in A_alpha, a supplied beta=[h]_alpha can be absorbed after semantic root and selected-branch verification.

For selected root x0, multiplicity r and Newton scale theta, every Taylor atom (sigma,k,a) is pushed to residual scale rho=sigma*theta^(k-r); equal residual scales aggregate exactly, two sources resonate iff sigma1/sigma2=theta^(k2-k1), the next edge is the rho=1 fiber, and staged vs one-shot Newton substitutions agree after this pushforward and aggregation.

negative_boundaries.statement: A first irrational translated root over rational coefficients can be handed off to a new single-root evaluation carrier.
Replacing an existing algebraic generator by a new translated root is invalid when old algebraic coefficient data remain live and no absorption certificate is supplied.
The Foundation verifies a supplied beta=[h]_alpha candidate; it does not promise or search for such an expression.
Signed coefficients in resonant Newton edge polynomials are algebraic-compression coefficients, not signed branch mass semantics.
Equal residual-scale/Taylor-degree atoms are aggregated; the residual jet does not recover their original source provenance.
The translated-root real selector is downstream and does not replace WBRC-T41 smallest-positive critical-root semantics.
